# Content Writing

Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source skill (MIT), listed here with credit to its creator @guia-matthieu (ClawFu). Discovered via skills.sh. A practical writing discipline built on Ann Handley's "Everybody Writes": reader-first habits and rules for blog posts that engage, emails that get opened, social posts that stop the scroll, website copy that speaks to its audience, and thought leadership that builds credibility — including how to edit your own work with a professional eye and how to keep producing consistently. Honest notes: it teaches craft, not taste — subject-matter judgment stays yours; the book it draws on is from 2014 (2nd edition 2022), so platform-specific tactics may date while the principles hold; unlike its sibling conversion-copywriting, this one is about content quality and consistency, not conversion mechanics — use both, for different jobs. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
